description: Runs 14 real, read-only checks of a public website homepage: reachability, HTTPS, indexability, robots.txt, search and AI crawler access, sitemap, title, meta description, H1, canonical, language, structured data, server-rendered text and /llms.txt. Each check shows what was found. The result also carries a rough 0-100 score worked out from those checks only: it is Stargo Growth's own yardstick for the basics, not a score from Google or any AI company, and it does not predict rankings or inquiries. A home page that cannot be opened gets no score; a check that could not be read on a very large page is marked unread and costs no points.
name: check_website
title: Check a website
